'''Sunfall Peak''' was a location on a [[Unidentified backwater planet|planet]] which harbored an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial communications hub|communications hub]]. It was [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|raided]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Age of Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sunfall Peak appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]], released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Age of Rebellion" />
